concept_label: 上一次户口登记地相对出生地关系（2011）
value_labels: 1=Same as birthplace; 2=Another village/neighborhood in this county/city; 3=Another county/city in this province; 4=Another province
value_semantics: categorical nominal response; preserve wave-specific categories and do not infer missing/skip as a substantive category
mapping_status: candidate historical/social residential-context exposure; wave-specific item, response categories, and routing reviewed
caveat: Asked only on the retrospective hukou-history route (BC008=1 and BC009=1 or 3). Categories capture broad relation/distance; the city/county/province detail fields are excluded.

concept_label: 上一次户口登记地相对出生地/常住地关系（2013）
value_labels: 1=Birthplace; 2=Permanent address; 3=Another village/neighborhood in permanent-address county/city/district; 4=Other county/city/district
value_semantics: categorical nominal response; preserve wave-specific categories and do not infer missing/skip as a substantive category
mapping_status: candidate historical/social residential-context exposure; wave-specific item, response categories, and routing reviewed
caveat: Asked only when the retrospective-history route applies (BC008=1 and BC009=1 or 3). The 2013 reference categories differ from 2011; geographic text/detail child fields are not part of this concept.

concept_label: 当前户口登记地与首次户口登记地不同的原因（2011）
value_labels: 1=Marriage; 2=Go to school; 3=Employment; 4=Retirement/revolutionary retirement; 5=Sent down to countryside; 6=Migration; 7=Whole-village migration; 8=Escape of famine; 9=Other
value_semantics: categorical nominal response; preserve wave-specific categories and do not infer missing/skip as a substantive category
mapping_status: candidate historical/social residential-context exposure; wave-specific item, response categories, and routing reviewed
caveat: Asked only for specified combinations of retrospective first-hukou relation and current hukou location (BC009/BC013/BC005 route). Treat as conditional reason, not an all-person migration measure; open other text is excluded.

concept_label: 上一轮访谈时户口类别
value_semantics: categorical nominal response; preserve wave-specific categories and do not infer missing/skip as a substantive category
mapping_status: candidate historical/social residential-context exposure; wave-specific item, response categories, and routing reviewed
caveat: Asked only when the preloaded prior-wave hukou-type record was rejected in the returner route. It describes the previous interview, not current hukou type; structural skips are not a hukou category.
